AI.theoretical_framework: 海洋租金理论、财政治理理论、可持续发展理论、蓝色经济理论、资源诅咒理论
AI.method: 采用教义学和分析法，研究尼日利亚税法下的海上税收结构和范围、租金捕获工具的有效性，以及财政条款与国家发展需求的匹配度。
AI.findings: 尼日利亚税法2025为税收提供了正式法律基础，但受限于薄弱的基于价值的租金机制、财政漏洞、与可持续发展目标不匹配。存在收入捕获、透明度和代际公平方面的持续差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了海洋租金捕获理论在发展中国家海上能源治理中的应用，为财政设计与可持续发展目标的整合提供了理论框架，丰富了蓝色经济转型背景下的税收治理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议加强租金捕获条款、设立专项发展基金、增强透明度和问责制，将财政设计与国家蓝色经济和后石油转型战略相结合，使海上能源税收成为国家发展的变革性工具。

title: Peer-to-peer carsharing as an effective way to reduce car overuse
affiliations: University of Bari "Aldo Moro" - Department of Economics, Management and Business Law, University of Bari "Aldo Moro" - Department of Economics, Management and Business Law and

detail.title: Peer-to-peer carsharing as an effective way to reduce car overuse
detail.abstract: We study the market of peer-to-peer carsharing, a market where owners rent their cars out to nonowners in exchange for a price. In a model where individuals take into account the effects of their mobility decisions on the environment, but this green sensitivity is heterogeneously distributed across them, we show that the introduction of peer-to-peer carsharing may lead to both an increase or a decrease in total car usage (and thereby emissions), but is likely to yield more beneficial effects in less green populations or when the distribution of green sensitivity is more polarized. We consider the possibility that individuals suffer from present bias and therefore end up using the car more than they originally intended. We show that peer-to-peer carsharing can curb this behavior and, in some cases, fully prevents car overuse.

AI.tldr: 研究P2P汽车共享市场，分析其对汽车使用量和排放的影响。在考虑环境敏感度异质性的模型中，P2P汽车共享可能增加或减少总汽车使用量，但在环保意识较低或环保敏感度分布更极化的群体中效果更佳。同时考虑现时偏差问题，发现P2P汽车共享可以抑制过度用车行为。
AI.research_question: P2P汽车共享市场的引入如何影响总汽车使用量和排放？在考虑个体环境敏感度异质性和现时偏差的情况下，P2P汽车共享会产生怎样的环境效应？
AI.motivation: 随着共享经济的发展，P2P汽车共享市场日益重要，但其对环境的影响尚不明确。需要理解在考虑个体环保意识差异和行为偏差的情况下，这种新兴市场模式对汽车使用和排放的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境经济学和行为经济学理论，结合环保敏感度异质性分布和现时偏差（present bias）概念，构建P2P汽车共享市场模型。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含环保敏感度异质性分布的P2P汽车共享市场模型，分析市场均衡和汽车使用决策，考虑现时偏差对用车行为的影响。
AI.findings: 1. P2P汽车共享可能增加或减少总汽车使用量（及排放）；2. 在环保意识较低的群体中或环保敏感度分布更极化的情境下，P2P汽车共享的环境效益更显著；3. P2P汽车共享可以抑制现时偏差导致的过度用车行为，在某些情况下完全防止汽车过度使用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将环保敏感度异质性纳入P2P汽车共享市场分析；2. 探讨现时偏差在共享经济环境效应中的作用；3. 揭示环保敏感度分布特征对共享经济环境效益的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供指导：在环保意识较低的社区推广P2P汽车共享可能获得更大环境效益；2. 为共享经济平台设计提供参考：考虑如何利用市场机制抑制行为偏差导致的过度消费；3. 帮助理解共享经济在不同社会群体中的差异化影响。

reference: IMF Working Paper No. 2026/030
title: Optimal Exchange Rate Policy with Oil Shocks
affiliations: Sabanci University and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Optimal Exchange Rate Policy with Oil Shocks

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study optimal monetary and exchange rate policy in a small open economy facing oil price shocks. In a model with segmented financial markets that generate endogenous UIP deviations, the first-best allocation is achieved through a combination of interest rate policy and foreign exchange intervention (FXI). Monetary policy stabilizes domestic inflation and the output gap, while FXI targets the UIP wedge to offset financial frictions. Oil price shocks endogenously move the net foreign asset position, giving rise to financial imbalances that make FXI essential—a mechanism distinct from exogenous financial shocks highlighted in the literature. Quantitatively, for a calibrated oil exporter, suboptimal regimes such as a free float or a simple peg entail sizable welfare losses of around 2% in consumption-equivalent terms, though peg, and especially peg with fuel subsidies, can outperform free floats. Overall, FXI is crucial to break the destabilizing link between real commodity shocks and financial risk premia.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨小型开放经济体面临油价冲击时的最优货币与汇率政策。在存在分割金融市场导致内生UIP偏离的模型中，最优配置通过利率政策与外汇干预(FXI)组合实现。货币政策稳定国内通胀与产出缺口，FXI则针对UIP楔子以抵消金融摩擦。油价冲击内生影响净外国资产头寸，产生金融失衡，使FXI至关重要。对校准的石油出口国，次优制度如自由浮动或简单钉住汇率导致约2%消费等值福利损失，但钉住汇率(尤其配合燃料补贴)可能优于自由浮动。
AI.research_question: 小型开放经济体面临油价冲击时，如何设计最优的货币政策和汇率政策组合？特别是，在存在金融市场分割导致内生UIP偏离的情况下，利率政策和外汇干预各自应发挥什么作用？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要关注外生金融冲击下的政策设计，但忽略了油价等实际商品冲击如何内生影响金融失衡。油价冲击通过影响净外国资产头寸产生金融风险溢价变化，需要专门的政策工具应对。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于小型开放经济模型，引入分割金融市场假设，导致内生UIP偏离(uncovered interest parity deviations)。模型包含油价冲击、金融摩擦、货币政策与外汇干预等要素。
AI.method: 理论建模与数值模拟相结合。构建包含金融市场分割的DSGE模型，推导最优政策规则，然后对石油出口国进行校准和福利分析，比较不同政策制度表现。
AI.findings: 1. 最优政策组合：货币政策稳定国内通胀与产出缺口，FXI针对UIP楔子抵消金融摩擦；2. 油价冲击通过净外国资产头寸内生影响金融失衡，使FXI至关重要；3. 对石油出口国，次优制度(自由浮动/简单钉住)导致约2%消费等值福利损失；4. 钉住汇率(尤其配合燃料补贴)可能优于自由浮动。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示实际商品冲击(油价)与金融风险溢价的内生联系机制；2. 提出针对UIP楔子的FXI政策框架，区别于传统外生金融冲击应对；3. 阐明货币政策与FXI在应对不同类型冲击时的分工理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为石油出口国提供具体政策组合建议；2. 量化不同汇率制度的福利成本；3. 证明FXI在打破商品冲击与金融风险溢价恶性循环中的关键作用；4. 为政策制定者提供钉住汇率配合燃料补贴的可行替代方案。

reference: IMF Working Paper No. 2026/032
title: Nowcasting GDP Growth for Kenya
affiliations: , Johns Hopkins University, International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund (IMF) - Research Department

detail.title: Nowcasting GDP Growth for Kenya

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper develops a nowcasting model to produce timely estimates of quarterly GDP growth for Kenya. Nowcasting combines official monthly indicators with digital transaction data. Exploiting strong comovement of macroeconomic time series, a few latent factors summarize aggregate dynamics and enhance forecasts. The model is updated with each data release, decomposing revisions into predictable and news components. Results demonstrate robust performance of the nowcasting model in data-constrained environments and show that nowcasting is applicable to low-income countries.

AI.tldr: 该论文为肯尼亚开发了一个实时预测模型，结合官方月度指标和数字交易数据来预测季度GDP增长，在数据受限的低收入国家环境中表现出稳健性能。
AI.research_question: 如何为肯尼亚这样的低收入国家开发有效的实时GDP增长预测模型？
AI.motivation: 低收入国家通常面临数据稀缺和发布滞后的挑战，需要开发能够利用有限数据及时预测经济状况的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因子模型理论，利用宏观经济时间序列的强相关性，通过少数潜在因子捕捉总体经济动态。
AI.method: 实时预测模型，结合官方月度指标和数字交易数据，利用因子分析提取潜在因子，模型随数据发布不断更新，将修订分解为可预测部分和新信息部分。
AI.findings: 模型在数据受限环境中表现稳健，实时预测方法适用于低收入国家，数字交易数据能有效补充传统指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了实时预测方法在低收入国家的应用，验证了因子模型在数据稀缺环境中的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为肯尼亚政策制定者提供了及时的经济监测工具，展示了数字数据在传统统计体系薄弱国家的补充价值。

title: Tiered Climate Clubs: Global Abatement Without Global Agreement
affiliations: Colorado State University, Fort Collins

detail.title: Tiered Climate Clubs: Global Abatement Without Global Agreement
detail.abstract: This paper develops a novel two-tier climate policy structure to mitigate global carbon emissions without requiring broad multilateral cooperation. Extending Nordhaus's (2015) climate club, countries in the ``second tier'' must price carbon at a fixed fraction of the average carbon price within the first tier, or face trade penalties. This matching rule creates two reinforcing mechanisms. First, by requiring partial carbon pricing by non-participating countries, the policy shifts abatement toward lower-cost opportunities outside the coalition, substantially improving global cost-effectiveness. Second, higher abatement by first-tier countries induces additional abatement by second-tier countries, strengthening incentives for leadership. The stable first-tier coalition consists of the United States and the European Union. In equilibrium, this coalition sets carbon prices at roughly 60\% of the global Social Cost of Carbon. The resulting agreement achieves global abatement four and a half times higher than the uncoordinated Nash equilibrium and approximately one-third of the globally efficient level. If participation by the United States is exogenously constrained, the remaining stable first-tier coalitions consist of the EU paired with either the UK or Australia. In these cases, equilibrium abatement rises by only a modest amount relative to the uncoordinated Nash outcome, compared to the much larger gains achieved under EU--US leadership.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的两层气候政策结构，通过要求第二层国家按第一层平均碳价的一定比例定价碳，否则面临贸易惩罚，来减少全球碳排放。该机制无需广泛的多边合作，通过美国-欧盟领导联盟可实现全球减排量比非协调纳什均衡高4.5倍。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种无需广泛多边合作的气候政策结构来有效减少全球碳排放？
AI.motivation: 全球气候合作面临集体行动困境，多边协议难以达成。需要设计一种机制，既能激励主要排放国领导减排，又能促使非参与国采取部分减排行动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Nordhaus（2015）气候俱乐部理论，扩展为两层结构：第一层为领导联盟，第二层为跟随国家。采用匹配规则和贸易惩罚机制。
AI.method: 理论模型分析，构建两层气候政策结构，分析稳定联盟形成、均衡碳价设定和全球减排效果。
AI.findings: 稳定的第一层联盟为美国和欧盟，设定碳价约为全球社会碳成本的60%。该协议实现的全球减排量比非协调纳什均衡高4.5倍，达到全球效率水平的约三分之一。若美国不参与，欧盟与英国或澳大利亚的联盟只能实现有限的减排增益。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了气候俱乐部理论，提出了两层政策结构；揭示了匹配规则的双重强化机制：将减排转向低成本机会，以及通过领导激励促进跟随国减排。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际气候政策设计提供了可行方案：通过美欧领导联盟和部分碳定价要求，无需全球多边协议即可实现显著减排；识别了关键领导国家组合。

title: Medals and Mindsets: How Women's Olympic Competitiveness Advances Gender Equality

detail.title: Medals and Mindsets: How Women's Olympic Competitiveness Advances Gender Equality
detail.abstract: Can female athletic success reshape beliefs about women's competitive capacity and advance gender equality? We study this question in the context of China's return to the Olympics, combining comprehensive athlete records from 1984-2004 with detailed census data. Exploiting variation in the timing of each prefecture's first female Olympic medalist and differential exposure across birth cohorts, we find that hometown female medalists significantly narrow gender gaps in educational attainment, while male medalists produce no comparable effects. To address potential endogeneity, we employ a Bartik-style instrument leveraging the 1991 Soviet collapse as an exogenous shock to medal opportunities across sports. We further show that media coverage framing female achievements as evidence of women's competitiveness helps explain these effects, and that female medalists shift fathers' beliefs about daughters' competitive capacity rather than directly inspiring girls. Taken together, our findings suggest that publicized female success can challenge gender stereotypes and promote equality.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，中国女性奥运冠军的成功能够显著缩小家乡地区的性别教育差距，而男性冠军则无类似效果。媒体对女性成就的报道有助于改变性别刻板印象，特别是通过影响父亲对女儿竞争能力的认知。
AI.research_question: 女性运动员的成功能否重塑人们对女性竞争能力的信念并促进性别平等？
AI.motivation: 探讨女性在竞技体育中的成功是否能够挑战性别刻板印象，特别是在中国这样的传统社会中，女性奥运冠军的成就是否能对家乡地区的性别平等产生积极影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会认知理论、性别刻板印象理论和榜样效应理论，研究女性成功如何通过媒体传播改变社会对女性竞争能力的认知。
AI.method: 利用1984-2004年中国奥运运动员记录和详细人口普查数据，采用双重差分法分析各地级市首次出现女性奥运冠军的时间差异对不同出生队列的影响，并使用1991年苏联解体作为外生冲击构建Bartik式工具变量解决内生性问题。
AI.findings: 家乡女性奥运冠军显著缩小了性别教育差距，而男性冠军无类似效果；媒体将女性成就报道为女性竞争能力的证据有助于解释这些效应；女性冠军主要通过改变父亲对女儿竞争能力的信念而非直接激励女孩来发挥作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 为女性成功如何挑战性别刻板印象提供了实证证据；揭示了榜样效应的性别差异机制；展示了媒体框架在塑造社会认知中的重要作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为促进性别平等提供了具体政策启示：应更多宣传女性在传统男性主导领域的成功；媒体应注重将女性成就框架为能力而非例外；父亲在女儿教育决策中的角色值得关注。

title: The Intersection of Biodiversity and Climate Change: Implications for International Enviromental Law
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Intersection of Biodiversity and Climate Change: Implications for International Enviromental Law
detail.abstract: The intersection between biodiversity and climate change presents profound challenges for global ecosystems and human societies. This article explores how these two critical environmental issues intersect, highlighting the implications for international environmental law. As climate change accelerates, it threatens species diversity and disrupts ecological balances, leading to dire consequences for both wildlife and human populations that rely on ecosystem services. The article analyzes existing legal frameworks and their effectiveness in addressing the dual crises of biodiversity loss and climate change. It emphasizes the need for a cohesive legal approach that recognizes the interconnectedness of these issues and advocates for stronger international cooperation. By examining case studies and policy responses, this work underscores the urgency for legal reform to protect biodiversity while combating climate change. Ultimately, it calls for innovative legal solutions that not only safeguard our planet's rich biological heritage but also foster resilience in the face of an uncertain climate future.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨生物多样性与气候变化交叉问题对国际环境法的影响，分析现有法律框架的有效性，强调需要综合性法律方法应对双重危机。
AI.research_question: 生物多样性与气候变化交叉问题如何影响国际环境法？现有法律框架在应对生物多样性丧失和气候变化双重危机中的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 气候变化加速威胁物种多样性、破坏生态平衡，对人类和野生动物产生严重后果，需要法律框架有效应对这一交叉性环境危机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际环境法理论、生态系统服务理论、环境治理理论、气候变化与生物多样性交叉影响理论。
AI.method: 法律框架分析、案例研究、政策响应分析、文献综述。
AI.findings: 现有法律框架在应对生物多样性丧失和气候变化交叉问题上存在不足，需要更综合的法律方法；国际合作的加强是解决双重危机的关键。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了生物多样性与气候变化交叉影响的法律理论框架，提出了综合性环境治理的理论模型，丰富了国际环境法的交叉学科研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供法律改革建议，促进国际环境合作，推动创新性法律解决方案，增强生态系统在气候变化下的韧性。

title: Dominance, Geometry, and Dynamics
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Dominance, Geometry, and Dynamics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. This research received no specific grant from any funding agency.
declarations.funderStatement: None, independent research.

detail.abstract: This paper establishes a structural separation between order, geometry, and dynamics to clarify why Pareto efficiency, equilibrium selection, and regime shifts must be treated as distinct objects. We formalize Pareto efficiency as an order-theoretic property induced by dominance, invariant to any metric. We then separate this invariant order from geometry by distinguishing dominance from distance to efficiency, yielding an inefficiency decomposition Γ(𝑦) into a dominance state and a metric-dependent magnitude. Dynamics are introduced as a third, independent layer; dynamics select realizable outcomes via attractors. Regime shifts correspond to topological changes in the efficient set, in attractor structure, or in their alignment, and cannot be resolved by geometric re-scaling. The framework provides a substrate-independent foundation for analyzing optimization, equilibrium selection, and regime change across strategic, economic, and ecological systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文建立了一个结构框架，将秩序、几何和动力学分离，以澄清帕累托效率、均衡选择和制度变迁必须被视为不同对象的原因。帕累托效率被形式化为由支配关系诱导的序论性质，对任何度量都不变。然后通过区分支配与效率距离，将不变秩序与几何分离，得到效率分解Γ(𝑦)。动力学作为第三独立层引入，通过吸引子选择可实现结果。制度变迁对应于有效集、吸引子结构或其对齐方式的拓扑变化。
AI.research_question: 如何建立结构框架来清晰区分帕累托效率、均衡选择和制度变迁这三个概念？为什么它们必须被视为不同的分析对象？
AI.motivation: 现有文献常常混淆帕累托效率、均衡选择和制度变迁，缺乏一个统一的框架来明确区分这些概念。这导致在战略、经济和生态系统的分析中，对优化、均衡选择和制度变迁的理解存在模糊性。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 序论：帕累托效率作为由支配关系诱导的序论性质
2. 几何理论：区分支配状态和效率距离
3. 动力学系统理论：通过吸引子选择可实现结果
4. 拓扑学：制度变迁作为拓扑变化
AI.method: 理论框架构建方法：通过建立结构分离框架，将秩序（序论）、几何（度量）和动力学（动态系统）作为三个独立层进行分析。形式化帕累托效率为序论性质，提出效率分解Γ(𝑦)，并引入动力学作为选择机制。
AI.findings:
1. 帕累托效率是序论性质，对任何度量都不变
2. 效率可以分解为支配状态和度量依赖的幅度
3. 动力学通过吸引子选择可实现结果
4. 制度变迁对应于有效集、吸引子结构或其对齐的拓扑变化，不能通过几何重新缩放解决
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 建立了秩序、几何和动力学的结构分离框架
2. 形式化了帕累托效率作为序论性质
3. 提出了效率分解Γ(𝑦)的概念
4. 将制度变迁理论化为拓扑变化
5. 提供了跨战略、经济和生态系统的底物独立分析基础
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为分析优化问题提供了清晰的概念框架
2. 帮助区分均衡选择和效率分析
3. 为理解制度变迁提供了理论基础
4. 可应用于战略决策、经济政策和生态系统管理
5. 防止在分析中将不同概念混淆

title: Who Pays When Tax Administration Improves? Revenue, Compliance, and Behavioral Responses to Georgia’s Large Taxpayer Office
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), , International Monetary Fund (IMF), Georgia Revenue Service (Ministry of Finance), Georgia Revenue Service (Ministry of Finance) and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Who Pays When Tax Administration Improves? Revenue, Compliance, and Behavioral Responses to Georgia’s Large Taxpayer Office

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In 2021, the Republic of Georgia established a Large Taxpayer Office (LTO) to strengthen tax administration and improve compliance among firms that contribute a disproportionate share of revenue. This paper draws on that quasi-experiment to estimate the causal impact of intensive oversight, with no change in tax rates, on taxpayer behavior and revenue collection using administrative data from 2017–2024. Our study exploits both the 2021 introduction of the LTO and the revision of eligibility thresholds in 2024. Estimating a weighted difference-in-differences design, we find that LTO assignment raised annual tax assessments by about 0.4–0.7 percent of GDP, concentrated in VAT and withholding taxes. When we examine the channels, we find that the LTO raised compliance by combining targeted enforcement with improved taxpayer services, while audits became fewer but more selective. The impacts are largest in sectors with strong third-party reporting and high transaction traceability. Our findings underscore that reforms to tax administration can deliver significant gains in fiscal capacity, generate fiscal space, and support development.

AI.tldr: 格鲁吉亚设立大纳税人办公室（LTO）作为准实验，研究强化税收征管（不改变税率）对纳税人行为和税收收入的影响。研究发现LTO使年度税收评估增加约GDP的0.4-0.7%，主要通过增值税和预扣税实现，效果在第三方报告强、交易可追溯性高的行业最显著。
AI.research_question: 强化税收征管（不改变税率）对纳税人行为和税收收入的因果影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 许多发展中国家面临税收征管能力薄弱的问题，但关于强化征管（不改变税率）对税收收入的因果效应证据有限。格鲁吉亚设立大纳税人办公室提供了一个准实验机会来研究这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收遵从理论、征管效率理论、第三方报告机制对税收遵从的影响、交易可追溯性与税收征管效果的关系。
AI.method: 利用格鲁吉亚2017-2024年行政数据，采用加权双重差分法（weighted difference-in-differences），利用2021年LTO设立和2024年资格门槛修订作为准实验。
AI.findings: 1. LTO使年度税收评估增加约GDP的0.4-0.7%，主要集中在增值税和预扣税；2. LTO通过针对性执法和改进纳税人服务提高遵从度，审计次数减少但更具选择性；3. 在第三方报告强、交易可追溯性高的行业效果最显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了强化税收征管（不改变税率）对税收收入的因果效应证据；2. 揭示了征管改革通过组合策略（执法+服务）提高遵从度的机制；3. 阐明了第三方报告和交易可追溯性在征管效果中的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为发展中国家税收征管改革提供实证依据；2. 表明征管改革可显著增强财政能力、创造财政空间；3. 为政策制定者提供针对性征管策略的设计参考。

title: Legacy-to-Cloud Semantic Regression Validation: A Framework for Detecting Meaning Drift in Modernized Systems
affiliations: Independent,  and

detail.title: Legacy-to-Cloud Semantic Regression Validation: A Framework for Detecting Meaning Drift in Modernized Systems
detail.abstract: Modernization and cloud migration of legacy systems are typically confirmed using functional regression testing, data reconciliation testing, and performance testing methods. Functional regression testing methods confirm that a new system works as expected technically but do not identify semantic regression-another type of defect wherein the new system works functionally, but has different meanings, interpretations of intent, and/or policy interpretation compared to the legacy system. These types of regressions are particularly risky for regulated and mission critical environments as they contain decades worth of business logic, edge cases, and institutional knowledge. Legacy-to-Cloud Semantic Regression Validation (LCSRV)-A structured process for identifying, measuring and mitigating semantic drift during system modernization-was developed to address this issue. LCSRV enhances traditional regression testing through the addition of semantic checkpoints, invariant-based validation, domain-aligned scenario models, and meaning-preserving comparison methodologies. LCSRV also allows for the systematic validation of the intended behavior of the system rather than simply determining whether the outputs are equivalent. An applied case study based on a healthcare eligibility modernization program demonstrates the use of the LCSRV Framework in practice. Controlled test scenarios and pseudo-metrics were used to illustrate how semantic regressions may occur and how they can be identified, even when conventional regression tests pass. The results showed that semantic drift can occur in the order of precedence for rules, the conditional interpretation of rules, and temporal logic, and therefore indicate that explicit semantic validation should be an integral part of modernization programs. The proposed methodology offers modernization teams a defendable, repeatable, and auditable process for maintaining the meaning of their systems throughout cloud transformations, which will enhance the quality assurance and compliance practices currently employed by many organizations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了LCSRV框架，用于在系统现代化和云迁移过程中识别、测量和缓解语义漂移问题，弥补传统功能回归测试无法检测语义回归的缺陷。
AI.research_question: 如何在系统现代化和云迁移过程中有效识别和验证语义回归，确保新系统在保持功能正确性的同时，其语义含义、意图解释和政策解释与遗留系统保持一致？
AI.motivation: 传统功能回归测试只能验证技术功能正确性，但无法检测语义回归——即新系统功能正常但含义、意图解释或政策解释与遗留系统不同的缺陷。这种缺陷对受监管和关键任务环境特别危险，因为这些系统包含数十年的业务逻辑、边缘案例和机构知识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于语义验证理论，强调系统现代化中语义一致性的重要性。框架包括语义检查点、基于不变量的验证、领域对齐的场景模型和意义保持比较方法等核心概念。
AI.method: 开发了LCSRV框架，包含语义检查点、不变验证、领域对齐场景模型和意义保持比较方法。通过医疗资格现代化项目的案例研究，使用控制测试场景和伪度量来演示语义回归的发生和识别。
AI.findings: 语义漂移可能发生在规则优先级顺序、规则条件解释和时间逻辑等方面。即使传统回归测试通过，语义回归仍然可能发生。案例研究表明LCSRV框架能够有效识别这些语义问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了系统现代化中语义验证的理论框架，将语义一致性作为独立于功能正确性的重要维度。引入了语义回归的概念和分类，为系统现代化质量保证提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为现代化团队提供了可辩护、可重复、可审计的语义验证流程，增强组织现有的质量保证和合规实践。框架可应用于受监管和关键任务环境的系统现代化项目。

title: Olympic Success and Gender Equality: How Media Narratives Shape Social Norms

detail.title: Olympic Success and Gender Equality: How Media Narratives Shape Social Norms
detail.abstract: Does female athletic achievement in the Olympic Games influence broader gender equality? We study this question in the context of China's return to the Olympics in 1984, combining comprehensive athlete records from 1984-2004 with detailed census data. Using a two-way fixed-effects design, we exploit variation in the timing of each prefecture's first female Olympic medal and differential exposure across cohorts who still could make education decisions versus those beyond that window. We find that the emergence of a hometown female medalist significantly reduces gender gaps in education and improves women's labor market outcomes. To address potential endogeneity in medal timing, we construct a Bartik-style instrument based on shifts in Soviet presence and relative strength across sports following the 1991 collapse of the Soviet Union, which generated exogenous variation in Chinese prefectures' medal opportunities. Mechanism analyses indicate that media framing-rather than coverage intensity-drives these effects: in People's Daily, female medalists are disproportionately portrayed through genderequality narratives rather than national pride. Together, the results suggest that publicized female achievement can challenge entrenched gender stereotypes and foster broader gender equality.

AI.tldr: 研究中国女性奥运奖牌获得者的出现如何影响家乡地区的性别平等，发现女性奥运成就通过媒体平等叙事而非报道强度，显著减少教育性别差距并改善女性劳动力市场结果。
AI.research_question: 女性在奥运会上的体育成就是否会影响更广泛的性别平等？
AI.motivation: 探讨女性体育成就作为社会变革催化剂的可能性，特别是在中国1984年重返奥运会的背景下，研究女性运动员的成功如何挑战根深蒂固的性别刻板印象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会认知理论、榜样效应理论和媒体框架理论，研究女性体育成就如何通过媒体叙事影响社会性别观念和行为。
AI.method: 采用双向固定效应设计，利用1984-2004年全面运动员记录和详细人口普查数据，分析每个地区首次获得女性奥运奖牌的时间变化，以及不同队列（仍可做出教育决策的群体与已过决策窗口的群体）的差异暴露。使用基于苏联解体后苏联存在和体育相对实力变化的Bartik式工具变量解决奖牌时间的内生性问题。
AI.findings: 家乡女性奥运奖牌获得者的出现显著减少了教育性别差距，改善了女性劳动力市场结果。机制分析表明，媒体框架（而非报道强度）驱动这些效应：在《人民日报》中，女性奖牌获得者更多地通过性别平等叙事而非民族自豪感来描绘。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 为女性体育成就作为性别平等催化剂的理论提供实证支持；2) 阐明媒体框架在塑造社会性别观念中的关键作用；3) 扩展了榜样效应理论在体育领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供证据，支持投资女性体育项目以促进性别平等；2) 为媒体从业者提供指导，强调平等叙事的重要性；3) 为教育工作者和社区领袖提供利用女性榜样促进性别平等的策略。

title: Time Is Not Authority: On the Structural Failure of Temporal Control Systems
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Time Is Not Authority: On the Structural Failure of Temporal Control Systems
detail.abstract:
This paper identifies a structural failure mode underlying modern digital systems: the substitution of temporal order for legitimacy. In many automated infrastructures: financial markets, blockchains, AI agents, and social media platforms; actions execute because time advanced, not because they were explicitly permitted. We argue that this represents a category error: time can order events, but it cannot authorize them.

We introduce the concept of temporal control systems, in which execution is triggered solely by temporal progression, and show that such systems are inherently unstable because they lack a mechanism to revoke, pause, or deny action. Drawing on control theory, financial instability, blockchain economics, and AI safety, we demonstrate that this failure mode appears across domains whenever execution is justified by continuity rather than permission.

The paper proposes explicit authorization as a missing control primitive and argues that no large-scale automated system can remain stable without it. By reframing recent crises in finance, computation, and attention as failures of temporal authority, the paper provides a unifying structural explanation for instability in digital civilization.

AI.tldr: 该论文识别了现代数字系统的一个结构性失效模式：用时间顺序替代合法性。在金融、区块链、AI和社交媒体等自动化基础设施中，行动因时间推移而执行，而非因明确授权。作者认为这是范畴错误：时间能排序事件，但不能授权事件。论文提出显式授权作为缺失的控制原语，并论证没有大规模自动化系统能在缺乏授权的情况下保持稳定。
AI.research_question: 现代数字系统中，用时间顺序替代合法性作为执行依据的结构性失效模式是什么？这种失效模式如何导致系统不稳定？如何通过显式授权解决这一问题？
AI.motivation: 观察到金融、区块链、AI和社交媒体等自动化基础设施中普遍存在一种模式：行动因时间推移而自动执行，而非基于明确授权。这种"时间触发"机制导致系统缺乏撤销、暂停或拒绝行动的能力，造成跨领域的不稳定问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 控制理论（系统稳定性分析）、金融不稳定理论、区块链经济学、AI安全理论。核心概念是"时间控制系统"（temporal control systems）和"时间权威"（temporal authority）的范畴错误。
AI.method: 跨领域案例分析：分析金融、区块链、AI和社交媒体等不同领域的自动化系统，识别共同的结构性失效模式。理论推导：基于控制理论分析时间控制系统的固有缺陷。概念论证：提出显式授权作为必要的控制原语。
AI.findings: 1. 时间控制系统（仅由时间推进触发的系统）具有内在不稳定性，缺乏撤销、暂停或拒绝行动的机制；2. 用时间顺序替代合法性是范畴错误；3. 这种失效模式在金融、计算和注意力经济等领域普遍存在；4. 显式授权是维持大规模自动化系统稳定性的必要控制原语。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"时间控制系统"概念框架；2. 识别"时间权威"的范畴错误；3. 提供跨领域系统不稳定性的统一结构解释；4. 将显式授权理论化为关键控制原语。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为金融、区块链、AI和社交媒体系统的设计者提供稳定性改进方向；2. 提出在自动化系统中实施显式授权机制的具体建议；3. 为监管和政策制定提供理论依据；4. 帮助系统架构师识别和避免时间控制陷阱。

title: Can Virtual Reality Enhance Scope Sensitivity? Experimental Evidence from the Amazon Rainforest

detail.title: Can Virtual Reality Enhance Scope Sensitivity? Experimental Evidence from the Amazon Rainforest

declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was preregistered and approved by the Research Ethics Committee of the Lon- don School of Economics and Political Science.
declarations.funderStatement: Funding for this research is gratefully acknowledged from the Department of Geography and Environment at the London School of Economics and Political Science. No external funding was received.

publicationDetails.detailsText: This paper was originally published as Grantham Research Institute on Climate Change and the Environment Working Paper No. 433 (London School of Economics and Political Science)

detail.abstract: High-quality video presentations generate scope-sensitive willingness to pay (WTP) for Amazon rainforest conservation as effectively as immersive virtual reality (VR), while offering greater accessibility and lower cost. Using a preregistered 2×2 between-subjects experimental design, participants were randomly assigned to VR or video presentations and asked their WTP for conservation programmes protecting 20% and 50% of the Amazon rainforest. Both formats successfully elicited scope-sensitive valuations, with scope elasticities of 0.588 for VR and 0.576 for video, within the empirically plausible range for environmental goods. With equivalent scope sensitivity, video represents the recommended approach for most stated preference applications. Exploratory within-VR analyses revealed that presence, realism, and discomfort moderated scope sensitivity, with higher presence and realism strengthening scope responsiveness and discomfort weakening it. These findings validate immersive VR as capable of eliciting scope-sensitive valuations for remote ecosystems with high non-use values, while establishing video's equivalent performance at substantially lower implementation costs.

AI.tldr: 高质量视频展示与沉浸式VR在激发亚马逊雨林保护支付意愿方面效果相当，都能产生范围敏感估值，但视频成本更低、更易获取。
AI.research_question: 视频展示与沉浸式虚拟现实在激发亚马逊雨林保护的范围敏感支付意愿方面效果是否相当？
AI.motivation: 评估不同展示媒介（VR vs 视频）在环境估值研究中的效果和成本效益，为选择更经济有效的评估方法提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境经济学中的支付意愿理论、范围敏感性理论、媒介效果理论（VR的沉浸感与视频的易获取性）。
AI.method: 预注册的2×2被试间实验设计，随机分配参与者接受VR或视频展示，询问他们对保护20%和50%亚马逊雨林的支付意愿。
AI.findings: 1. VR和视频都能成功激发范围敏感估值（范围弹性分别为0.588和0.576）；2. 两种媒介在范围敏感性方面效果相当；3. VR中的临场感、真实感和不适感会调节范围敏感性。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了沉浸式VR能够激发对具有高非使用价值的远程生态系统的范围敏感估值，同时确立了视频展示的同等理论效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 推荐视频作为大多数陈述偏好应用的首选方法，因其在保持同等范围敏感性的同时，实施成本显著更低、可及性更高。

title: Evaluating Sectoral Effectiveness of India's Skill Development Programme (PMKVY 2.0)
affiliations: Fergusson College

detail.title: Evaluating Sectoral Effectiveness of India's Skill Development Programme (PMKVY 2.0)
detail.abstract: This paper examines the sectoral performance of India’s Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 2.0) by analysing the relationship between training intensity and employment placement outcomes across skill sectors. Using officially reported sector-wise data, the study highlights substantial heterogeneity in placement performance and finds that higher training volumes do not consistently result in better employment outcomes. The results suggest mismatches between skill provision and labour market demand in several sectors, underscoring the need for demand-driven training, stronger industry linkages, and improved programme targeting. The paper offers policy-relevant insights for improving the effectiveness of large-scale skill development initiatives in India.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了印度PMKVY 2.0技能培训计划在不同行业的绩效，发现培训强度与就业安置结果之间没有一致的正相关关系，揭示了技能供给与劳动力市场需求之间的不匹配问题。
AI.research_question: 印度PMKVY 2.0技能培训计划在不同行业的培训强度与就业安置结果之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 评估大规模技能发展计划的实际效果，了解培训强度与就业结果之间的关系，为政策改进提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技能培训有效性理论、劳动力市场匹配理论、公共政策评估框架。
AI.method: 使用官方报告的行业数据，分析培训强度与就业安置结果之间的关系，采用定量分析方法。
AI.findings: 1. 不同行业的安置绩效存在显著异质性；2. 更高的培训量并不总是带来更好的就业结果；3. 多个行业存在技能供给与劳动力市场需求不匹配的问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 丰富了技能培训计划评估的理论框架；2. 提供了培训强度与就业结果关系的实证证据；3. 深化了对技能供给与市场需求匹配问题的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供改进技能培训计划的建议；2. 强调需求驱动培训的重要性；3. 建议加强产业联系和改善项目目标定位。

title: Structural Localization and Regime Selection: Multi-Seed Validation of Telegraph Dynamics via Operational Detection

detail.title: Structural Localization and Regime Selection: Multi-Seed Validation of Telegraph Dynamics via Operational Detection
detail.abstract: We demonstrate that graph-based telegraph dynamics exhibit structural localization that statistically selects dynamical regimes (underdamped vs. overdamped), and that this selection is operationally detectable from partial, noisy timeseries observations without spectral knowledge. Using 50 independent graph realizations (500 graphs total, n = 60-103 nodes) and analyzing 18 nontrivial Laplacian eigenmodes per graph, we establish three core findings via multi-seed validation: (C1) Certain topologies generate localized eigenmodes (272/500 graphs, 54% hit rate), (C2) localization exhibits population-level coupling to regime selection (∆r = 0.211, CI 95 = [0.175, 0.247], p < 0.001) with 38% seed-to-seed stability validating Causal Memory Gravity (CMG) predictions, and (C3) regimes are operationally detectable achieving PR-AUC = 0.853. The 50-fold sample increase (10 → 500 graphs) yields 7× tighter confidence intervals and establishes statistical significance for the localization-regime coupling that was ambiguous in single-seed analysis. The 38% seed stability validates CMG's prediction that "structure may fluctuate while causal constraints persist," distinguishing genuine structure-dependence from null effects (≈5% expected) or universal laws (≈90% expected).

AI.tldr: 该研究证明图上的电报动力学存在结构局域化现象，能统计性地选择动力学状态（欠阻尼vs过阻尼），且这种选择可通过部分噪声时间序列观测进行检测，无需频谱知识。
AI.research_question: 图拓扑结构如何影响电报动力学的局域化现象？这种结构局域化是否与动力学状态选择存在统计关联？能否从部分噪声观测中检测这种状态选择？
AI.motivation: 理解复杂网络中的结构-动力学关系，特别是图拓扑如何通过局域化现象影响动力学行为，这对于从有限观测推断系统状态具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 图论、拉普拉斯特征模分析、电报动力学、因果记忆重力（CMG）理论、结构局域化理论
AI.method: 使用500个图（50个独立实现，每个图60-103个节点），分析每个图的18个非平凡拉普拉斯特征模，采用多种子验证方法，通过统计分析和操作检测评估局域化与状态选择的关联。
AI.findings: 1）特定拓扑结构产生局域化特征模（54%命中率）；2）局域化与状态选择存在群体水平耦合（∆r=0.211，p<0.001），38%种子稳定性验证CMG预测；3）状态可通过操作检测实现（PR-AUC=0.853）。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了CMG理论预测"结构可能波动而因果约束持续存在"，建立了图拓扑局域化与动力学状态选择的统计关联，区分了真实结构依赖与零效应或普适定律。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供从部分噪声时间序列检测动力学状态的方法，无需完整频谱知识；通过50倍样本量将置信区间缩小7倍，为实际应用提供统计可靠性。

title: The Three-Stage Transition: How Institutional Tolerance-Language Shifts from Act-Constraint to Judgment-Sanction
affiliations: University of Exeter

detail.title: The Three-Stage Transition: How Institutional Tolerance-Language Shifts from Act-Constraint to Judgment-Sanction
detail.abstract: This article identifies and analyses a structural transition in UK equality and anti-harassment law through which normative language originally constraining acts of interference has been progressively extended to constrain evaluative judgment itself. Drawing on close doctrinal analysis of the Equality Act 2010, s 26, university conduct codes, criminal communications statutes, and the Higher Education (Freedom of Speech) Act 2023, the article documents a three-stage pattern: from act-constraint (Stage 1), through an evaluative gateway created by subjective-effect tests (Stage 2), to judgmentas-sanction-target (Stage 3). Case law analysis-spanning Forstater v CGD Europe, Miller v College of Policing, Lee v Ashers Baking Company, Ngole v University of Sheffield, and cognate decisions-reveals that courts have intermittently recognised and corrected this transition, but that the statutory architecture continues to enable it. Comparative analysis confirms that the transition is strongest where legal frameworks provide evaluative gateways and weakest where strict act-speech distinctions are maintained. The article concludes that stable rights-protective frameworks require explicit statutory differentiation between act-constraint and judgment-constraint, and that the 'purpose or effect' formulation in s 26 constitutes a structural vulnerability that legislative reform has not yet adequately addressed.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了英国平等与反骚扰法律的结构性转变：从约束行为（第一阶段），到通过主观效果测试创建评价性门槛（第二阶段），再到将评价判断本身作为制裁目标（第三阶段）。研究发现这一转变在提供评价性门槛的法律框架中最强，而在严格区分行为与言论的框架中最弱。
AI.research_question: 英国平等与反骚扰法律如何从约束行为转变为约束评价判断本身？这种结构性转变的法律机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 识别和分析英国法律中一个重要的结构性转变：原本用于约束干扰行为的规范性语言，如何逐渐扩展到约束评价判断本身，这对言论自由和权利保护框架构成挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律结构转变理论、言论自由与平等权利平衡理论、行为约束与判断约束的区分理论。
AI.method: 1. 教义学分析：对《2010年平等法案》第26条、大学行为准则、刑事通讯法规、《2023年高等教育（言论自由）法案》进行详细分析；2. 案例法分析：分析Forstater v CGD Europe、Miller v College of Policing、Lee v Ashers Baking Company、Ngole v University of Sheffield等关键案例；3. 比较分析：对比不同法律框架下的转变强度。
AI.findings: 1. 发现三阶段转变模式：行为约束→主观效果测试创建评价性门槛→将评价判断本身作为制裁目标；2. 法院已间歇性地识别并纠正这一转变，但法定架构仍使其持续存在；3. 在提供评价性门槛的法律框架中转变最强，在严格区分行为与言论的框架中最弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了法律结构性转变的三阶段理论模型；2. 识别了"目的或效果"表述作为结构性漏洞的理论意义；3. 发展了行为约束与判断约束的区分理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 指出稳定的权利保护框架需要在法律中明确区分行为约束与判断约束；2. 建议立法改革需要解决《平等法案》第26条中"目的或效果"表述的结构性漏洞；3. 为政策制定者提供改进法律框架的具体方向。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Finance: A Comparative Evaluation of Vector, Hierarchical, and Graph-Based RAG Models
affiliations: , , , , , , AIG, , Cornell Financial Engineering Manhattan and

detail.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Finance: A Comparative Evaluation of Vector, Hierarchical, and Graph-Based RAG Models
detail.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems have emerged as a powerful paradigm for enterprise knowledge retrieval, particularly in large, distributed corporate information environments. We develop and evaluate a RAG-based knowledge retrieval framework over BlackRocks corporate website corpus. We implement and systematically benchmark five RAG architectures-Vanilla RAG, RAPTOR, CRAG, LightRAG, and LinearRAGacross seven representative query types spanning factual, thematic, and comparative questions. To assess retrieval quality in enterprise settings where ground truth is distributed and context-dependent, we introduce three evaluation metrics: Wrong Category Rate, Context Deficiency Rate, and Incorrect Link Retrieval Rate. Empirical results indicate that graph-based architectures demonstrate superior retrieval robustness, with LinearRAG achieving zero observed failures across all metrics. Hierarchical approaches such as RAPTOR excel at thematic synthesis, while CRAGs self-correcting mechanism with web-search fallback improves resilience to corpus limitations. The system processes 1,130 BlackRock articles into a unified, searchable knowledge base supporting multiple retrieval paradigms. Our findings highlight the trade-offs between flat, hierarchical, corrective, and graph-based RAG architectures, offering practical design insights for deploying retrieval-grounded LLM systems in large-scale financial enterprise environments.

AI.tldr: 本文开发并评估了基于RAG的企业知识检索框架，在BlackRock公司网站语料库上系统比较了五种RAG架构，提出了适用于企业环境的评估指标，发现图基架构在检索鲁棒性方面表现最优。
AI.research_question: 在大型分布式企业信息环境中，不同RAG架构（Vanilla RAG、RAPTOR、CRAG、LightRAG、LinearRAG）在应对事实性、主题性和比较性查询时的检索性能如何？
AI.motivation: RAG系统已成为企业知识检索的强大范式，特别是在大型分布式企业信息环境中。然而，在企业环境中，由于真实答案分布且依赖于上下文，评估检索质量面临挑战，需要开发适合企业环境的评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 检索增强生成（RAG）理论框架，包括扁平架构、层次架构、自校正架构和图基架构等不同RAG变体的理论基础。
AI.method: 将1,130篇BlackRock文章处理为统一可搜索知识库，系统评估五种RAG架构（Vanilla RAG、RAPTOR、CRAG、LightRAG、LinearRAG）在七种代表性查询类型上的表现，引入三种评估指标：错误类别率、上下文缺失率和错误链接检索率。
AI.findings: 图基架构表现出最优的检索鲁棒性，LinearRAG在所有指标上实现零失败观察；层次架构如RAPTOR擅长主题综合；CRAG的带网络搜索回退的自校正机制提高了对语料库限制的韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了适用于企业环境的RAG评估框架，包括三种新的评估指标；系统比较了扁平、层次、校正和图基RAG架构的理论差异；为企业环境中检索增强LLM系统的设计提供了理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了基于BlackRock公司网站语料库的RAG知识检索框架；提供了不同RAG架构在企业环境中的性能比较；为大规模金融企业环境中部署检索增强LLM系统提供了实用设计指导。

title: AI-Driven Deployment and Cloud Migration Strategies for Stable Software Releases

detail.title: AI-Driven Deployment and Cloud Migration Strategies for Stable Software Releases

declarations.declarationOfInterest: AI-Driven Deployment and Cloud Migration Strategies for Stable Software Releases

detail.abstract: The growing complexity of modern software systems has made manual deployment difficult to manage at scale. Artificial intelligence offers practical support across the deployment lifecycle, from traffic control to rollback decisions. This article discusses how AI supports blue and green deployment strategies through automated traffic orchestration, anomaly detection, predictive rollback, performance tuning, and user experience monitoring. It outlines the role of machine learning, deep learning, generative models, and reinforcement learning in improving release safety and system reliability. Common operational use cases such as load testing, circuit breakers, chaos engineering, caching, and cloud migration are also examined. The discussion shows how AI-enabled deployment reduces downtime, lowers release risk, and supports continuous improvement in production environments. The AI-Integrated Enhanced Deployment Strategy leverages machine learning and intelligent automation to revolutionize software delivery, optimizing CI/CD pipelines for greater speed, reliability, and accuracy. By automating testing, proactively detecting errors, and dynamically managing resources, this approach reduces deployment risks, overcomes infrastructure complexities, and ensures faster, more secure release cycles. This approach is critical for modern MLOps, allowing organizations to manage model drift and ensure AI models are consistently updated in production environments.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了AI如何支持蓝绿部署策略，通过自动化流量编排、异常检测、预测性回滚、性能调优和用户体验监控，利用机器学习、深度学习、生成模型和强化学习等技术提升发布安全性和系统可靠性，减少停机时间并降低发布风险。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何支持蓝绿部署策略，并通过自动化技术提升软件部署的安全性、可靠性和效率？
AI.motivation: 现代软件系统日益复杂，手动部署难以大规模管理。人工智能为整个部署生命周期提供实用支持，从流量控制到回滚决策，帮助组织应对部署挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于蓝绿部署理论、持续集成/持续部署（CI/CD）理论、MLOps理论，结合机器学习、深度学习、生成模型和强化学习等AI技术框架。
AI.method: 采用文献综述和案例分析的方法，探讨AI在部署策略中的具体应用，包括自动化流量编排、异常检测、预测性回滚、性能调优、用户体验监控等技术实现。
AI.findings: AI支持的部署策略能够显著减少停机时间、降低发布风险，通过自动化测试、主动错误检测和动态资源管理，优化CI/CD流程，提高发布速度和安全性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI集成增强部署策略的理论框架，将AI技术与传统部署策略相结合，为软件工程和MLOps领域提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了具体的AI部署实施指南，包括负载测试、断路器、混沌工程、缓存和云迁移等实际用例，帮助企业在生产环境中实现持续改进。

title: Economic Globalization and Renewable Energy Investment: Cross-Border Dynamics

detail.title: Economic Globalization and Renewable Energy Investment: Cross-Border Dynamics
detail.abstract:
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PLEASE CITE THE PUBLISHED VERSION:

Akusta, E. (2026). Economic Globalization and Renewable Energy Investment: Cross-Border Dynamics. In Financial Frontiers in Energy Markets: Policy Frameworks, Risk Management, and Investment Strategies in a Global Context (pp. 81-96). Cham: Springer Nature Switzerland. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-032-16738-5_6

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Request the full text: emre.akusta@klu.edu.tr

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Globalization has become a key dynamic shaping renewable energy investment through technology transfer, capital mobility, and trade networks. This study examines the impact of economic globalization and its dimensions on renewable energy investments for the global economy, using global data from 1970 to 2022. The Johansen co-integration test confirmed the existence of long-run relationships in the study. Long-run coefficient estimates were made using the DOLS and FMOLS methods. The findings show that economic globalization generally has a positive impact on renewable energy investments. The long-run coefficient results show that a 1% increase in the economic globalization index increases renewable energy investments by approximately 0.06–0.07%. Analyzing the sub-components, the impact of trade globalization is significantly stronger. A 1% increase in the trade globalization index increases renewable energy investments by 0.10–0.12%. In contrast, financial globalization was estimated with negative coefficients. A 1% increase in the financial globalization index was found to reduce investments by approximately 0.05%. This result indicates that short-run capital movements, exchange rate fluctuations, and financial instability have a negative impact on long-run energy projects. Furthermore, economic growth was also found to support renewable energy investments. Overall, it emerged that the impact of globalization is not one-sided; while it offers opportunities for renewable energy investments, financial integration harbors vulnerabilities when appropriate policy frameworks are lacking.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用1970-2022年全球数据，通过Johansen协整检验、DOLS和FMOLS方法，分析经济全球化对可再生能源投资的影响。研究发现经济全球化总体上对可再生能源投资有正向影响，但贸易全球化与金融全球化的影响方向相反。
AI.research_question: 经济全球化及其各维度（贸易全球化、金融全球化）如何影响全球可再生能源投资？
AI.motivation: 全球化通过技术转移、资本流动和贸易网络成为塑造可再生能源投资的关键动力，但全球化对可再生能源投资的具体影响机制和方向尚需实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于全球化理论，特别是经济全球化的多维度框架（包括贸易全球化和金融全球化），以及它们对长期能源投资的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用1970-2022年全球数据，采用Johansen协整检验确认长期关系，使用DOLS（动态最小二乘法）和FMOLS（完全修正最小二乘法）进行长期系数估计。
AI.findings: 1. 经济全球化指数每增加1%，可再生能源投资增加约0.06-0.07%；2. 贸易全球化指数每增加1%，可再生能源投资增加0.10-0.12%；3. 金融全球化指数每增加1%，可再生能源投资减少约0.05%；4. 经济增长支持可再生能源投资。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了全球化对可再生能源投资影响的异质性：贸易全球化正向影响，金融全球化负向影响；2. 强调了全球化影响的非单向性，既有机会也有脆弱性；3. 为全球化理论在能源投资领域的应用提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了区分贸易和金融全球化影响的实证依据；2. 强调了适当政策框架对缓解金融全球化负面影响的重要性；3. 为可再生能源投资者提供了全球化环境下的风险评估框架。

title: The Role of Sustainable Engineering Management in Market Differentiation and Brand Value Creation
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Role of Sustainable Engineering Management in Market Differentiation and Brand Value Creation
detail.abstract: In today's hyper-competitive business landscape, organizations are increasingly recognizing the pivotal role that sustainable engineering management plays in achieving market differentiation and enhancing brand value. This paper examines the integral relationship between sustainable engineering practices and their impact on brand perception, consumer loyalty, and overall market positioning. By integrating principles of sustainability into engineering management, companies can not only improve operational efficiencies but also foster innovative solutions that resonate with environmentally conscious consumers. The first section of this study provides a comprehensive overview of sustainable engineering management, defining its key components, methodologies, and frameworks. It highlights the importance of aligning engineering strategies with sustainability goals, noting how this alignment supports long-term business viability and market competitiveness. A focus on the Triple Bottom Line—balancing economic, environmental, and social impacts—serves as a foundational element in this exploration, demonstrating how sustainability can drive value creation across multiple dimensions. Subsequent sections delve into empirical case studies that illustrate successful implementation of sustainable engineering practices across various industries. These case studies provide insight into how organizations like Tesla and Interface have effectively leveraged sustainability as a core component of their engineering strategies, resulting in enhanced brand loyalty and a differentiated market presence. By prioritizing sustainable innovations, these companies have not only captured significant market share but have also established themselves as leaders in corporate social responsibility. Furthermore, the paper investigates the mechanisms through which sustainable engineering enhances brand value. It discusses the role of consumer perceptions, stakeholder engagement, and regulatory compliance in shaping brand reputation. Ultimately, the findings indicate that organizations that prioritize sustainable engineering management not only elevate their operational capabilities but also strengthen their brand equity in an increasingly sustainability driven marketplace. This study concludes by advocating for a paradigm shift in engineering management practices, encouraging organizations to adopt sustainable models that align with evolving consumer expectations and regulatory landscapes. By embracing this approach, firms can position themselves favorably in the market, ultimately achieving a competitive edge that drives both profitability and positive societal impact.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨可持续工程管理如何通过整合经济、环境和社会三重底线原则，提升品牌价值、消费者忠诚度和市场竞争力，并以特斯拉和Interface等企业案例说明成功实践。
AI.research_question: 可持续工程管理实践如何影响品牌认知、消费者忠诚度和市场定位？
AI.motivation: 在高度竞争的商业环境中，组织越来越认识到可持续工程管理在实现市场差异化和提升品牌价值中的关键作用，需要理解可持续工程实践与品牌绩效之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三重底线理论（经济、环境、社会平衡）、可持续工程管理框架、品牌价值理论、消费者感知理论。
AI.method: 综合文献综述与实证案例研究（包括特斯拉和Interface等企业的案例分析）。
AI.findings: 优先考虑可持续工程管理的组织不仅能提升运营能力，还能在日益关注可持续性的市场中增强品牌资产；可持续工程实践通过改善消费者感知、利益相关者参与和法规合规性来塑造品牌声誉。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了可持续工程管理与品牌价值之间的理论联系，扩展了三重底线理论在工程管理领域的应用，为可持续品牌建设提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了实施可持续工程管理的实践指南，展示了如何通过可持续工程实践实现市场差异化，增强品牌忠诚度，并获得竞争优势。

title: Stakeholder Relationships and Value Creation in Digital Platforms: A Business Model Approach

publicationDetails.detailsText: Zeamari, Ilyass, "Stakeholder Relationships and Value Creation in Digital Platforms: A Business Model Approach" (2025). PACIS 2025 Proceedings. 14. https://aisel.aisnet.org/pacis2025/dig_plat/di/14

detail.abstract: This study examines how stakeholder relationships in platform business models drive value creation and support sustainable development. Prior research has mainly focused on platform users and economic factors to explain value creation. In contrast, this study integrates economic, relational, and nonfinancial dimensions, considering both primary and secondary actors. To answer the question of how stakeholder relationships contribute to sustainable value creation, this study adopts a conceptual approach based on platform business model theory and the literature on trust and reputation. This study proposes a new conceptual model that illustrates how collaboration among stakeholders improves platform performance and sustainability. The results advance the theoretical understanding by linking platform strategies to sustainability outcomes and provide valuable insights for managers to strengthen stakeholder collaboration and ecosystem resilience. This conceptual model lays the groundwork for empirical validation and future research on sustainable value creation in digital platforms.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一个概念模型，解释平台商业模式中利益相关者关系如何通过经济、关系和非财务维度驱动可持续价值创造，强调多方协作对平台绩效和可持续发展的影响。
AI.research_question: 平台商业模式中的利益相关者关系如何促进可持续价值创造？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注平台用户和经济因素来解释价值创造，忽略了利益相关者关系的多维性（经济、关系和非财务维度）以及主要和次要参与者的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台商业模式理论、信任与声誉文献
AI.method: 概念研究方法，基于平台商业模式理论和信任与声誉文献，提出新的概念模型
AI.findings: 提出了一个新的概念模型，展示利益相关者之间的协作如何改善平台绩效和可持续性
AI.theory_contributions: 通过将平台战略与可持续性结果联系起来，推进了理论理解；为可持续价值创造研究奠定了基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了加强利益相关者协作和生态系统韧性的宝贵见解；概念模型为实证验证提供了基础

title:
The Delegation Dilemma: 
Why Agentic AI Requires Organizational Redesign
affiliations: and

detail.title:
The Delegation Dilemma: 
Why Agentic AI Requires Organizational Redesign
detail.abstract: As organizations increasingly deploy agentic artificial intelligence systems that can plan, coordinate, and execute actions, AI adoption is entering a new organizational phase. Unlike earlier AI applications that primarily supported human decision-making, agentic systems act within workflows, initiating tasks and producing consequences across systems and time. While these capabilities promise gains in speed and scalability, many organizations struggle to scale beyond pilots into stable production. Existing explanations often emphasize technical risk, overlooking the organizational conditions required to govern autonomous action. This whitepaper argues that the central challenge of agentic AI adoption is organizational rather than technical. As AI systems transition from tools to actors, organizations implicitly delegate authority without redesigning decision rights, coordination mechanisms, and accountability structures. By reframing agentic AI adoption as an organizational design problem, this paper explains why many initiatives stall after experimentation and clarifies the implications for leaders seeking to integrate autonomous systems more coherently and responsibly.

AI.tldr: 论文认为，代理式AI采用的核心挑战是组织设计问题而非技术风险。当AI系统从工具转变为行动者时，组织在未重新设计决策权、协调机制和问责结构的情况下隐含地授权，导致许多试点项目难以规模化。
AI.research_question: 为什么许多组织在代理式AI试点后难以实现规模化稳定生产？代理式AI采用的核心挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 组织越来越多地部署能够规划、协调和执行行动的代理式AI系统，AI采用进入新阶段。这些系统在流程中行动，跨系统和时间启动任务并产生后果。尽管这些能力承诺提高速度和可扩展性，但许多组织难以超越试点进入稳定生产。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织设计理论、委托-代理理论、决策权分配、协调机制、问责结构。论文将代理式AI采用重新定义为组织设计问题。
AI.method: 概念性白皮书分析，基于组织理论和AI采用文献，通过理论框架解释现象。
AI.findings: 代理式AI采用的核心挑战是组织而非技术。当AI系统从工具转变为行动者时，组织隐含地授权但未重新设计决策权、协调机制和问责结构，导致许多倡议在实验后停滞。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将代理式AI采用重新定义为组织设计问题而非技术风险问题；2) 识别AI从工具到行动者的转变如何需要重新设计组织架构；3) 提供解释为什么许多AI倡议在试点后停滞的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 帮助领导者理解代理式AI采用的组织挑战；2) 提供整合自主系统更一致和负责任的指导；3) 强调需要重新设计决策权、协调机制和问责结构以实现规模化。

title: Emotion-aware Speech Processing for Intelligent Virtual Assistants
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Emotion-aware Speech Processing for Intelligent Virtual Assistants
detail.abstract: This study investigates emotion-aware speech processing techniques for intelligent virtual assistants, focusing on how speech emotion recognition enhances interaction quality, personalization, and contextual understanding in human-AI communication. The research synthesizes recent advances in transformer-based models, hybrid deep-learning architectures, and multimodal approaches to speech emotion detection, and evaluates their suitability for real-time virtual assistant systems (Onyekwelu-Udoka et al., 2025; Hu et al., 2022). The methodology integrates a comparative literature analysis with an architectural evaluation of existing emotion-aware assistant frameworks to assess performance, scalability, and deployment feasibility (Zadeh & Alaeifard, 2023). The findings indicate that incorporating emotion-aware speech processing significantly improves user satisfaction, engagement, and task efficiency. However, persistent challenges remain, including dataset bias, computational latency, and ambiguity in emotional and contextual interpretation (Chatterjee et al., 2021; Li, 2025). The study concludes that emotion-aware speech processing is a critical component of next-generation intelligent assistants and recommends the development of unified multimodal frameworks alongside robust ethical and governance strategies to support scalable and responsible real-world adoption (Addu, 2024; Abdelaziz et al., 2025).

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了情感感知语音处理技术在智能虚拟助手中的应用，分析了语音情感识别如何提升人机交互质量、个性化和情境理解，并评估了相关技术的性能、可扩展性和部署可行性。
AI.research_question: 情感感知语音处理技术如何提升智能虚拟助手的交互质量、个性化和情境理解？
AI.motivation: 随着智能虚拟助手的普及，提升人机交互的自然性和情感智能成为关键需求。当前系统缺乏情感感知能力，限制了交互质量和用户体验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Transformer的模型、混合深度学习架构、多模态语音情感检测方法，以及情感计算和人机交互理论。
AI.method: 整合比较文献分析和现有情感感知助手框架的架构评估，评估性能、可扩展性和部署可行性。
AI.findings: 情感感知语音处理显著提高用户满意度、参与度和任务效率。但仍面临数据集偏差、计算延迟、情感和情境解释模糊等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了情感感知语音处理的理论框架，提出了下一代智能助手的情感计算模型，为情感智能人机交互提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 推荐开发统一的多模态框架和稳健的伦理治理策略，支持可扩展且负责任的实际应用部署，为虚拟助手开发者提供技术路线图。

title: SAD Scheme Standing Orders

detail.title: SAD Scheme Standing Orders

publicationDetails.detailsText: Santa Clara Univ. Legal Studies Research Paper No. 6175358
publicationDetails.journalName: Santa Clara University School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The SAD Scheme is an abusive form of intellectual property enforcement that has quietly emerged as a significant part of current intellectual property practice. In response, a number of judges have recently adopted standing orders to regulate SAD Scheme practice in their courtrooms. This essay takes a snapshot of these standing orders and considers their appropriateness. It’s encouraging to see judges take steps to curb the SAD Scheme, but such efforts should embody the best practices of due process.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了针对SAD Scheme（一种滥用知识产权执法形式）的法庭常设命令，评估其适当性，并建议这些措施应体现正当程序的最佳实践。
AI.research_question: 针对SAD Scheme的法庭常设命令是否适当？这些命令是否体现了正当程序的最佳实践？
AI.motivation: SAD Scheme作为一种滥用知识产权执法的形式，已成为当前知识产权实践的重要组成部分，需要司法干预来规范其使用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识产权执法理论、正当程序原则、司法监管理论、最佳实践框架
AI.method: 文献分析、案例研究、对法庭常设命令的文本分析、比较分析
AI.findings: 法官采取措施遏制SAD Scheme是积极的，但现有常设命令在体现正当程序最佳实践方面存在不足，需要进一步完善。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了知识产权滥用执法的理论框架，提出了司法监管SAD Scheme的理论模型，丰富了正当程序在知识产权执法中的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法官制定更有效的常设命令提供指导，帮助识别和遏制SAD Scheme滥用，促进知识产权执法的公平性和正当性。

title: From Predictive Rationality to Feedback Rationality: Philosophical Foundations of Demand-Driven Contractual Systems

detail.title: From Predictive Rationality to Feedback Rationality: Philosophical Foundations of Demand-Driven Contractual Systems

AI.tldr: 本文提出需求驱动合同闭环理论（DDCCLT），作为对传统预测理性认知范式的补充，强调在制度执行层通过反馈循环实现持续学习与适应，以应对复杂适应系统中的不确定性。
AI.research_question: 在复杂适应系统环境下，如何通过制度设计克服传统预测理性的局限性，建立更具适应性和鲁棒性的合同治理机制？
AI.motivation: 传统制度基于预测理性范式，在相对稳定环境中有效，但在数字化、全球化、技术快速重组的当代社会经济系统中，未来无法从过去可靠推断，制度刚性反而成为脆弱性来源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 美国实用主义、控制论、过程哲学和当代复杂性经济学，构建了反馈理性作为制度认知的补充模式。
AI.method: 理论构建与哲学分析，通过概念重构和理论整合，发展需求驱动合同闭环理论（DDCCLT）。
AI.findings: DDCCLT不是取代预测理性，而是在制度执行层运作的二阶纠正机制，通过结构化反馈循环将需求信号转化为合同调整，解决静态合同的结构不完整性，增强制度在不确定性下的鲁棒性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出反馈理性作为制度认知的补充模式；2）重构合同治理的认识论基础；3）发展DDCCLT理论框架，为复杂适应系统中的制度设计提供新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为合同设计、政策制定和治理结构提供具体方法，通过嵌入反馈循环机制，使制度能够在执行过程中持续学习、适应和调整，提高在动态环境中的适应性和韧性。

title: Compliance Pooling in Maritime Shipping Under Emission Intensity Caps
affiliations: , The University of Sydney, The University of Sydney and The University of Sydney Business School

detail.title: Compliance Pooling in Maritime Shipping Under Emission Intensity Caps
detail.abstract: Regulation (EU) 2023/1805, as an influential measure with broad coverage and significant implications for global supply chains, is currently being implemented. It targets reducing emissions in maritime transport by capping the greenhouse-gas intensity of the energy used on board, while allowing compliance pooling to facilitate this transition. A healthy pooling market is key to incentivising a transition to cleaner shipping as an opportunity to sell surplus compliance units can make investment in a cleaner ship more financially attractive. To maximise this effect the threshold and penalty need to be tuned so that the cash flows to the compliant ship are maximised. The lower the emissions threshold, the lower the supply of surplus units, the higher their price, capped by the penalty, limiting revenue to the compliant ships. But the higher the supply of surplus units, the lower their price, also limiting revenue to the compliant ships. Studying price competition and using 2024 European Union maritime emissions-reporting data, this study investigates the shipping compliance market effect on companies' costs, profits, and penalties. It provides prescriptive insights for regulators on implementing emission-reduction policy and adopting market-based tools under dynamic market conditions.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了欧盟航运排放法规（EU 2023/1805）下的合规市场机制，探讨如何通过调整排放阈值和惩罚机制来最大化合规船舶的现金流，从而激励航运业向清洁能源转型。
AI.research_question: 欧盟航运排放法规下的合规市场机制如何影响航运公司的成本、利润和惩罚？如何通过调整排放阈值和惩罚机制来最大化合规船舶的现金流，从而激励航运业向清洁能源转型？
AI.motivation: 欧盟法规2023/1805作为一项覆盖范围广、对全球供应链影响重大的措施正在实施中。该法规旨在通过限制船上能源的温室气体强度来减少航运排放，同时允许合规池化机制来促进这一转型。健康的池化市场对于激励航运业向清洁能源转型至关重要，因为出售剩余合规单位的机会可以使投资清洁船舶更具财务吸引力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场机制理论、价格竞争理论、环境经济学中的排放交易机制理论、合规池化机制的经济激励理论。
AI.method: 采用价格竞争分析方法，并使用2024年欧盟航运排放报告数据进行实证研究，分析航运合规市场对公司成本、利润和惩罚的影响。
AI.findings: 研究发现排放阈值和惩罚机制之间存在权衡关系：排放阈值越低，剩余合规单位的供应量越少，价格越高（受惩罚上限限制），从而限制了合规船舶的收入；反之，剩余合规单位供应量越高，价格越低，同样限制了合规船舶的收入。需要优化阈值和惩罚机制以最大化合规船舶的现金流。
AI.theory_contributions: 为环境法规下的市场机制设计提供了理论框架，深化了对合规池化市场中价格形成机制和经济激励效应的理解，为动态市场条件下的政策工具设计提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构实施减排政策和采用市场工具提供了规范性建议，帮助优化排放阈值和惩罚机制设计，以最大化合规船舶的经济激励，促进航运业向清洁能源转型。

title: Between Clicks and Crowds: Operational Spillovers from Digital Engagement to Offline Care Quality
affiliations: University of Houston - C.T. Bauer College of Business, Guangdong University of Technology and City University of Hong Kong (CityU), affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Between Clicks and Crowds: Operational Spillovers from Digital Engagement to Offline Care Quality

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors are not aware of any conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors have no funders to report.

detail.abstract: At scale, physician-led online health consultation communities (OHCs) are increasingly becoming a front entrance to healthcare delivery. By enabling patient-centric physician selection under noisy reputation signals and patient bias, OHCs are reshaping healthcare demand and inducing new matching dynamics that can inadvertently spill over into offline inpatient operations. These platforms can disrupt capacity management and clinical quality as patient-driven self-routing reallocates demand across physicians in ways uncoordinated with offline clinical triage, challenges that the traditional healthcare operations were not designed, nor sufficiently prepared, to respond to. Though OHCs can improve patient access by extending physicians’ reach beyond physical boundaries, their cross-channel operational externalities on offline healthcare operations and inpatient quality remain unclear. We assemble a 28-month, operation-level panel dataset combining 166,076 inpatient episodes and online activity data of 484 physicians across four leading OHCs to examine our research questions. We find that OHC participation significantly worsens clinical outcomes indicating a negative operational externality, as evidenced by an increase in the length of hospital stay, deterioration in discharge status, and an elevation in readmission risk. We theorize and validate the critical role played by patient-doctor mismatch (PDM), defined as the severity-skill misalignment in how patients get treated by physicians, as a key operational mechanism. Mediation analyses show that physicians’ OHC participation elevates their inpatient volume and congestion, which in turn increases PDM and degrades quality, revealing a crowding-out pathway. Consistent with noisy quality signals induced on digital platforms, we find some evidence for a reputation-halo bias, whereby patients conflate popularity with clinical skill. We further identify heterogeneity: the adverse effects are mitigated among patients with an agricultural occupation who tend to rely on conventional provider-driven triage, and among female physicians whose online reputation signals might be less inflated by societal perceptions. We introduce PDM as an operational construct linking physicians’ digital engagement to offline quality degradation, thereby revealing how patient-centric platforms can disrupt operations and care quality in traditional offline healthcare settings.

AI.tldr: 在线医疗咨询社区（OHCs）虽然改善了患者就医可及性，但会通过患者-医生错配（PDM）机制对线下住院医疗质量产生负面溢出效应，导致住院时间延长、出院状况恶化和再入院风险升高。
AI.research_question: 在线医疗咨询社区（OHCs）的参与如何影响线下住院医疗质量和临床结果？其背后的运作机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着OHCs成为医疗服务的"前门"，患者驱动的自我分诊重新分配了医生间的需求，这种未与线下临床分诊协调的匹配动态可能对传统医疗运营产生溢出效应，但OHCs对线下医疗运营和住院质量的影响尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 患者-医生错配（PDM）理论：定义为患者病情严重程度与医生技能之间的错位；拥挤效应理论：OHCs参与增加医生线下工作量导致拥堵；声誉光环偏差理论：患者将在线声誉与临床技能混淆。
AI.method: 使用28个月的操作层面面板数据集，结合166,076个住院病例和484名医生在四个主要OHCs的在线活动数据，采用中介分析验证PDM机制。
AI.findings: OHCs参与显著恶化临床结果：住院时间增加、出院状况恶化、再入院风险升高。PDM是关键运作机制，医生OHCs参与增加住院量和拥堵，进而增加PDM并降低质量。存在声誉光环偏差，患者将在线声誉与临床技能混淆。农业职业患者和女性医生的负面影响较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 引入PDM作为连接医生数字参与与线下质量下降的操作性构念；揭示了以患者为中心的平台如何破坏传统线下医疗环境的运营和护理质量；扩展了数字平台溢出效应的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗管理者提供证据，表明需要协调在线和线下医疗运营；建议设计机制减少PDM；为政策制定者提供关于数字医疗平台监管的见解；帮助患者更理性地使用在线医疗平台。

title: From Guilds to Margins: A Historical-Economic Reclassification Study of the Vankar Community in India

detail.title: From Guilds to Margins: A Historical-Economic Reclassification Study of the Vankar Community in India
detail.abstract: This paper examines the historical-economic trajectory of the Vankar community through archaeological, epigraphic, trade, colonial economic, and census records. It argues that the contemporary classification of the community as a Scheduled Caste is not rooted in ritualpurity based social exclusion, but rather in a long process of economic displacement, deindustrialization, and administrative reclassification. Using evidence from Indus Valley archaeology (Lothal), Gupta-period inscriptions (Mandasor), Mughal-era trade systems, colonial tariff policy, famine records, and the 1931 Census of India, the study proposes that occupational collapse and loss of economic autonomy—rather than religious untouchability—were the primary drivers of social downgrading. The paper contributes to caste studies by introducing an economic-deindustrialization model of caste mobility and reclassification.

AI.tldr: 本文通过考古、铭文、贸易、殖民经济和人口普查记录，研究了Vankar社区的历史经济轨迹，认为该社区被列为表列种姓并非基于宗教纯洁性的社会排斥，而是经济流离失所、去工业化和行政重新分类的长期过程的结果。
AI.research_question: Vankar社区为何被归类为表列种姓？这种分类是基于宗教纯洁性的社会排斥，还是经济因素驱动的社会降级？
AI.motivation: 挑战传统种姓研究中过度强调宗教纯洁性和社会排斥的观点，揭示经济因素在种姓流动和重新分类中的重要作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济去工业化模型，强调职业崩溃和经济自主权丧失作为种姓流动的主要驱动力，而非宗教不可接触性。
AI.method: 多源历史证据分析：包括印度河流域考古（洛塔尔）、笈多王朝铭文（曼达索尔）、莫卧儿时期贸易体系、殖民关税政策、饥荒记录和1931年印度人口普查。
AI.findings: Vankar社区的社会降级主要是由职业崩溃和经济自主权丧失驱动的，而非宗教不可接触性。该社区经历了长期的经济流离失所、去工业化和行政重新分类过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 为种姓研究引入了经济去工业化模型，强调经济因素而非宗教因素在种姓流动和重新分类中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解表列种姓的形成机制提供了新的视角，有助于政策制定者更全面地考虑种姓问题的经济维度，而非仅仅关注社会排斥。

title: Market Effects on Liner Shipping Alliances and Cooperation Strategies
affiliations: , The University of Sydney, The University of Sydney and The University of Sydney Business School

detail.title: Market Effects on Liner Shipping Alliances and Cooperation Strategies
detail.abstract: Container shipping lines choose cooperation when it improves their profitability. The highly cyclical nature of demand for container shipping affects the profit of container shipping lines, and correspondingly, influences their cooperation strategies. Additionally, the profit of shipping lines depends on the fees they pay to ports and terminal operators, which, in turn, are influenced by the level of competition between terminal operators. Therefore, the motivation for shipping lines to ally is affected by the bargaining power they gain over customers, ports, and terminal operators. This research studies the combined effect of market demand and port competition on shipping line cooperation. An evolutionary game theory model is developed to study the dynamics of cooperation among shipping lines. Additionally, container ports and terminal operators compete to attract shipping lines by reducing their container handling fees while maintaining profitability. It is demonstrated that the cooperation among liner companies prevails as market demand increases relative to supply. Port and terminal operators' market power intensifies this effect by increasing fee savings. With high enough demand, cooperation dominates in the market in the form of vessel-sharing agreements or alliances. However, their evolutionary equilibrium cooperation depends on market shares, freight rate, and charter rate. Our computational results suggest that increasing demand fluctuations intensify cooperation, while increasing shipping capacity relative to demand weakens it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究市场需求与港口竞争对航运公司合作的综合影响，发现市场需求增加会促进航运公司合作，而港口运营商的市场力量会通过降低费用来强化这一效应。
AI.research_question: 市场需求和港口竞争如何共同影响集装箱航运公司的合作策略？
AI.motivation: 集装箱航运公司的合作决策受市场需求周期性波动的影响，同时港口和码头运营商的竞争会影响航运公司的成本结构，进而影响其合作动机。需要研究这两个因素的交互作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 演化博弈理论，用于分析航运公司合作策略的动态演化过程。
AI.method: 建立演化博弈理论模型，研究航运公司合作的动态演化；通过计算分析市场需求波动、运力供给等因素对合作均衡的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 市场需求相对于供给增加时，航运公司合作占主导；2. 港口和码头运营商的市场力量通过降低费用强化合作效应；3. 需求足够高时，合作以船舶共享协议或联盟形式主导市场；4. 演化均衡合作取决于市场份额、运费率和租船费率；5. 需求波动加剧会强化合作，而运力相对于需求增加会削弱合作。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将市场需求波动和港口竞争两个因素整合到航运公司合作决策分析中；2. 应用演化博弈理论分析航运公司合作的动态演化过程；3. 揭示了市场需求、港口竞争与合作策略之间的复杂互动关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为航运公司制定合作策略提供决策依据；2. 帮助港口运营商理解竞争策略对航运公司合作的影响；3. 为政策制定者监管航运市场提供理论支持；4. 帮助行业参与者预测市场需求变化对合作格局的影响。

title: Risk Propagation in the European Banking System
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF) - Western Hemisphere Department and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Risk Propagation in the European Banking System

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper applies network analysis to examine the impact of non-bank financial institutions (NBFIs) and financial market stress on contagion risk within the interbank network. Using network-based simulations on euro area banks’ supervisory data, we find that banks’ strong capital and liquidity buffers significantly reduce contagion through interbank exposures: base-line scenarios show only modest capital losses and no cascading defaults. In contrast, stress originating from NBFIs under heightened market volatility markedly amplifies systemic risk. These findings highlight NBFIs and market volatility as key amplifiers of financial stress in the euro area. Our findings call for integrating contagion models into system-wide stress testing and designing macroprudential policies that encompass the entire financial ecosystem. Such policies should account for amplification risks from banks’ NBFI exposures when calibrating buffers and identifying systemic institutions.

AI.tldr: 该研究运用网络分析方法，探讨非银行金融机构(NBFIs)和金融市场压力对银行间网络传染风险的影响。基于欧元区银行监管数据的模拟显示，银行充足的资本和流动性缓冲能显著降低传染风险，而NBFIs在波动市场环境下会成为系统性风险的重要放大器。
AI.research_question: 非银行金融机构(NBFIs)和金融市场压力如何影响银行间网络的传染风险？
AI.motivation: 传统银行间传染风险研究多关注银行体系内部，忽视了NBFIs和金融市场波动对系统性风险的放大作用，需要更全面地理解整个金融生态系统的风险传导机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络分析理论、系统性风险传染理论、宏观审慎监管框架
AI.method: 基于欧元区银行监管数据的网络模拟分析，构建银行间网络模型并进行压力测试模拟
AI.findings: 1) 银行充足的资本和流动性缓冲能有效降低传染风险，基准情景下仅出现有限资本损失且无连锁违约；2) NBFIs在高度市场波动环境下会显著放大系统性风险；3) NBFIs和市场波动是欧元区金融压力的关键放大器
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将NBFIs纳入银行间传染风险分析框架；2) 识别市场波动与NBFIs交互作用对系统性风险的放大机制；3) 扩展了金融网络传染理论的应用边界
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 建议将传染模型整合到全系统压力测试中；2) 呼吁设计覆盖整个金融生态系统的宏观审慎政策；3) 提出在缓冲校准和系统重要性机构识别时应考虑银行对NBFIs的风险暴露

title: Why Generative AI Strategies Fail: Reframing Governance as a Strategic Decision Architecture

detail.title: Why Generative AI Strategies Fail: Reframing Governance as a Strategic Decision Architecture
detail.abstract: The purpose of this paper is to challenge prevailing adoption and maturity-based approaches to generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) by arguing that most GenAI strategies fail not because of technological limitations, but because organizations do not redesign decision authority, accountability, and legitimacy for AI-supported decisions. The paper reframes GenAI governance as a strategic decision architecture problem and develops a conceptual model that explains how organizations can embed GenAI into their decision systems to convert adoption into sustained strategic decision value.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了当前基于采用和成熟度的生成式AI方法，认为大多数GenAI战略失败不是因为技术限制，而是因为组织没有为AI支持的决策重新设计决策权、问责制和合法性。论文将GenAI治理重新定义为战略决策架构问题，并开发了一个概念模型，解释组织如何将GenAI嵌入决策系统，将采用转化为持续的战略决策价值。
AI.research_question: 为什么大多数生成式AI战略未能实现持续的战略决策价值？组织如何通过重新设计决策架构来成功嵌入GenAI？
AI.motivation: 当前组织在实施生成式AI时过于关注技术采用和成熟度，而忽视了决策系统的重新设计，导致GenAI战略失败。需要从决策架构角度重新思考GenAI治理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略决策架构理论、组织治理理论、AI治理框架、决策权分配理论
AI.method: 概念模型开发、理论构建、文献综述、案例研究（基于摘要推断）
AI.findings: GenAI战略失败的主要原因是组织未能重新设计决策权、问责制和合法性，而非技术限制。成功嵌入GenAI需要将其视为战略决策架构问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 挑战了主流的采用和成熟度导向的GenAI方法；2) 提出了GenAI治理作为战略决策架构的新视角；3) 开发了将GenAI嵌入决策系统的概念模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为组织提供了重新设计决策架构的框架；2) 指导如何将GenAI采用转化为持续战略价值；3) 帮助避免常见的GenAI实施陷阱。

title: Data Confidence as a Strategic Capability: Turning Insights into Influence

detail.title: Data Confidence as a Strategic Capability: Turning Insights into Influence
detail.abstract: The purpose of this paper is to introduce data confidence as a strategic capability that enables executives to transform analytical insights into decision influence. While organizations increasingly invest in analytics and data governance, many struggle to embed data into strategic decision-making. This paper argues that the missing link is not analytical sophistication, but confidence in data as a credible, interpretable, and actionable input for strategy. Design/methodology/approach This paper adopts a conceptual and integrative approach, synthesizing insights from strategy, knowledge management, analytics capability, and decision-making literatures to develop data confidence as a strategic capability. Rather than employing empirical testing, the study draws on established theoretical and managerial research to identify the conditions under which data-based insights translate into strategic influence. The approach emphasizes managerial relevance and executive decision contexts, focusing on how trust, interpretability, governance structures, and organizational decision routines jointly shape confidence in data. By integrating these streams, the paper develops a conceptual framework that explains how data confidence enables executives to act on insights in strategic settings. Findings This paper advances three interrelated conceptual findings that explain why data-driven insights often fail to influence strategic decision-making and how data confidence operates as a strategic capability that enables insight to translate into influence. The first finding is that the strategic influence of data is determined less by data availability or analytical sophistication than by the degree of confidence decision-makers place in data-based insights. While organizations increasingly develop advanced analytics capabilities, these capabilities do not automatically shape strategic action. Data influences strategy only when executives perceive it as credible, interpretable, and relevant to their decision context. In the absence of such confidence, data remains informational rather than influential, regardless of its technical quality. The second finding is that data confidence is best understood as a multi-dimensional organizational capability rather than a single attribute of data or technology. Conceptually, data confidence comprises cognitive confidence, reflecting executives’ ability to interpret and make sense of data; relational confidence, reflecting trust in data sources and analytical processes; and structural confidence, reflecting governance mechanisms and decision routines that legitimize data use. These dimensions interact to shape whether insights are accepted, debated, or acted upon in strategic forums. Weaknesses in any one dimension can undermine overall confidence, even when analytical outputs are technically sound. The third finding is that data confidence functions as the critical mechanism through which insights are translated into influence within strategic decision processes. When confidence is high, executives are more likely to sponsor data-based arguments, defend them in deliberations, and integrate them into strategic choices. When confidence is low, insights are more easily overridden by intuition, experience, or organizational politics. From this perspective, data confidence represents a distinct strategic capability that shapes not only decision quality but also the distribution of influence within strategic conversations. Originality/value This paper makes a novel contribution by introducing data confidence as a distinct strategic capability that explains why data-driven insights often fail to influence executive decisionmaking. While prior research has emphasized data quality, analytics capability, or governance maturity, this paper shifts attention to the behavioral and organizational conditions under which data becomes influential in strategic contexts. By integrating insights from strategy, knowledge management, and decision-making literature, the paper reframes analytics not as a technical asset but as a source of strategic influence mediated by confidence. The value of the paper lies in offering executives a practical lens for diagnosing why analytics investments underperform and for designing confidence-building mechanisms that enable insights to shape strategic outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"数据信心"作为战略能力，解释为何数据分析洞察常无法影响战略决策。数据信心是连接分析洞察与决策影响的关键机制，包含认知、关系和结构三个维度。
AI.research_question: 为什么数据驱动的洞察常常无法影响战略决策？数据信心如何作为战略能力使洞察转化为影响力？
AI.motivation: 尽管组织在分析和数据治理方面投入增加，但许多组织难以将数据嵌入战略决策。缺失的环节不是分析复杂性，而是对数据作为可信、可解释和可操作战略输入的信心。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合战略、知识管理、分析能力和决策文献，将数据信心概念化为战略能力。框架包含认知信心（解释能力）、关系信心（信任数据源）和结构信心（治理机制）三个维度。
AI.method: 采用概念性和整合性方法，综合现有理论和实证研究，而非进行经验测试。强调管理相关性和高管决策情境，关注信任、可解释性、治理结构和组织决策惯例如何共同塑造数据信心。
AI.findings: 1. 数据战略影响力更多取决于决策者对数据洞察的信心程度，而非数据可用性或分析复杂性；2. 数据信心是多维组织能力，包含认知、关系和结构三个维度；3. 数据信心是洞察转化为战略影响力的关键机制，影响高管是否支持、辩护并整合数据观点。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将数据信心概念化为解释数据驱动洞察为何常无法影响高管决策的独特战略能力。将分析重新定义为通过信心调节的战略影响力来源，而非技术资产。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高管提供实用诊断工具，解释为何分析投资表现不佳，并设计信心构建机制使洞察能够塑造战略结果。强调需要建立多维信心能力而非单纯技术投资。

title: The Transformation of Supply Chain Management Driven by AI Agents
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Transformation of Supply Chain Management Driven by AI Agents
detail.abstract: As global supply chains face growing uncertainty and complexity, there is an urgent need for intelligent and adaptive optimization systems. This paper presents an Al Agent-driven framework that enables end-to-end autonomous decision-making across supply chain operations. By integrating generative Al, reinforcement learning, retrieval-augmented generation, and multimodal data fusion, we design two functional Al Agents: (1) an Inventory & Logistics Analysis Agent for dynamic replenishment planning and transportation routing, and (2) a Forecasting Agent for accurate demand forecasting with automated data preprocessing and parameter optimization. Empirical evaluations conducted in simulated supply chain environments demonstrate significant improvements in forecast accuracy, inventory turnover, and logistics agility compared to traditional Al approaches. The proposed framework offers a scalable, interpretable, and practically deployable architecture for transforming supply chain decision-making, contributing to the development of intelligent, resilient, and sustainable supply chain ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种AI Agent驱动的供应链优化框架，通过集成生成式AI、强化学习等技术，设计库存物流分析Agent和预测Agent，实现端到端自主决策，显著提升预测准确性、库存周转率和物流敏捷性。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个AI Agent驱动的框架来实现供应链端到端的自主决策优化？
AI.motivation: 全球供应链面临日益增长的不确定性和复杂性，迫切需要智能、自适应的优化系统来提升供应链的韧性、效率和可持续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于AI Agent理论、生成式AI、强化学习、检索增强生成和多模态数据融合等理论构建智能供应链决策框架。
AI.method: 设计两个功能性AI Agent：1）库存与物流分析Agent用于动态补货计划和运输路径规划；2）预测Agent用于需求预测，包含自动化数据预处理和参数优化。在模拟供应链环境中进行实证评估。
AI.findings: 相比传统AI方法，该框架在预测准确性、库存周转率和物流敏捷性方面均有显著提升，证明了其有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个可扩展、可解释、可实际部署的AI Agent驱动供应链决策架构，为智能、韧性、可持续供应链生态系统的发展做出理论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个实际可部署的供应链智能决策框架，能够帮助企业提升供应链运营效率、降低库存成本、增强应对不确定性的能力。
